input: Log ten hours of volunteer work this quarter

gold.taskTitle: Log Ten Hours of Volunteer Work This Quarter
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete and record ten hours of volunteer work within the current quarter.

questions.title: What type of volunteer work do you want to do?
questions.description: Understand the specific cause or activity the user has in mind, such as food banking, tutoring, animal shelter, environmental clean-up, etc.

questions.title: Do you already have a volunteer organization in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a specific organization or needs help identifying one to work with.

questions.title: When exactly does your quarter end?
questions.description: Establish the hard deadline by confirming the specific end date of the quarter the user is referring to.

questions.title: How many hours have you already completed so far?
questions.description: Determine the baseline so the plan covers only the remaining hours needed.

questions.title: How many hours per session can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Understand the user's availability in a single sitting to plan the right number of sessions.

questions.title: Is this goal required by someone, or self-motivated?
questions.description: Find out if the ten hours are mandated by an employer, school, or court, or if this is a personal goal, as this affects urgency and verification needs.

questions.title: How do you need to track or prove the hours logged?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs official sign-off, a specific app, a spreadsheet, or just a personal record to consider the goal complete.
